violations.description: Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager had an expired certificate or is no longer associated with this establishment. Unable to verify if any staff have current certificate.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. Upright reach in cooler in BOH prep area not maintaining proper temperatures. Service unit as needed.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Coffee counter not constructed colored of concrete. Doesn't meet any of the criteria for surfaces.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Cabinets rotting/dilapidated at coffee counter. Mold developing.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Prep cooler cutting board has need of thorough cleaning.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Counters/cabinets need cleaning.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not provided with sufficient mechanical ventilation. Restrooms not provided with mechanical ventilation.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Doorway between FOH & BOH not cased out. Large hole in at utility sink needs repair. Wood floor at ice machine rotting.

Control of insects, rodents, and other pests. — --Insect electrocution or trapping device was installed in an inappropriate location. Hang fly strips away from work surfaces. Currently hung near prep table cooler.
Ventilation hood systems - Design and construction. — --Ventilation hood system was not provided over all cooking equipment. Panini grill not located under hood.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Cutting board at prep cooler has build-up of food debris and is in need of cleaning.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. FOH cabinets/counters have build up of coffee grounds and debris and need cleaning.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not provided with sufficient mechanical ventilation. Restrooms not provided with mechanical ventilation.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors need cleaning in coffee prep area. Clean under and around equipment/refrigeration units/ice machine.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Doorway between FOH & BOH not cased out. Large hole in wall at utility sink needs repair.

Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. Mop currently placed in utility sink. Store in a manner that promotes proper drying.

Control of insects, rodents, and other pests. — --Insect electrocution or trapping device was installed in an inappropriate location. Fly strip hung from light fixture above prep table cooler in kitchen.
Food service manager certification. — --Person in charge did not hold an approved food service manager certificate. Current staff do not hold food service manager's certificate.
